newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Zeneca chart says bull run continues.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Zeneca chart says bull run continues.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Group, which have tripled in value since 1994, were showing no signs that the rally was running out of steam, technical analysts said.
By 1032 GMT, the shares had jumped 40-1/2p to 1,584, only 7p off their record peak amid renewed takeover speculation.
Technical analyst Robin Griffiths of HSBC James Capel said he did not intend to remove his buy recommendation on Zeneca shares.
"There are no indications that (the rally) is losing momentum," he said.
One important warning flag that the bull market was weakening would be if the share price crossed the 200-day moving average, currently at 1366, he said.
"But it doesn't look like that's going to happen," he said.
If the shares failed to hold major support, previously resistance, at 1400p, it would confirm that the market had topped out, he said.
Griffiths' next target for the shares -- up almost 25 percent since January fuelled in large part by recurring takeover talks -- is 2100p.
Chris Chaitow, an analyst with Robert Fleming Securities, said that the breakout in August over the 1400p level suggested there was more upside potential.
"There's nothing that has happened since they broke 1,400p that would make you alarmed," he said. "I'd only start worrying if they dropped below 1,520p or 1,500p."
